why: The owner wants a picture card for every theme in the Themes picker (2026-10-10), including the six new style themes. 22 of the 26 themes have none yet; Prism, Midnight Gallery, The Mint and Shipwreck already have theirs.
instructions: Any image AI: follow the Drive doc 'ART_START_HERE (any AI: images + video)'. Claim the job first ({request id}.CLAIMED-{model}.txt). Work in priority order: all priority 1 images (the 22 picker cards) first, then priority 2 (the 22 hero images). takes 2 = make 2 versions named _take1/_take2 before the extension. One image at a time; stop at the first failure or credit warning and say how far you got. Save to 'Titan Reliquary/art-incoming (AI images + video)/artreq_20261010-1700_theme-thumbnails/' with the exact file names, then write artreq_20261010-1700_theme-thumbnails.DONE.txt next to this request (one line per file: ok or skipped: reason; your model name and date).

deliverable_spec.card: 16:10, at least 1280x800, PNG; the subject must read at 220x138 px (the picker card size on a phone)
deliverable_spec.safe_area: keep the top-left third of heroes calm and darker (or plain paper on light themes): UI text sits there

global_style: Real photography, not a render: shot like a high-end editorial or luxury-watch campaign on a full-frame camera, shallow depth of field, true reflections, physically accurate materials (toned silver with micro-scratches, gold, brass, marble, walnut, velvet, glass), soft volumetric light, rich natural grading, fine film grain. Real-looking coins or bullion in a place that fits the mood. Calm, expensive, cinematic. Exception: an image whose `medium` names an illustration, pixel art, clay or poster style is made in that medium, at the same premium standard (clean, crafted, never cheap clip-art).
negative: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no faces, no hands, no 3D-render plastic look in the photo images, no oversaturation, no HDR halos, no warped or melting coins, no invented legible inscriptions
coin_rule: Coins look like real circulated or uncirculated world coins (a generic portrait, eagle or crest is fine); never invent a legible inscription.

images.prompt: Overhead 3/4 view of a conservator's daylight desk at noon: cream archival ledger paper with faint ruled lines, a brass jeweller's loupe, white cotton gloves and one toned silver coin under a warm desk lamp; beside it an old printed auction-catalogue page whose coin photo shows a visible halftone dot screen (no readable text). Light, warm, paper tones. Style from the owner's list: Halftone.

A single silver coin resting on the black lacquered lid of a grand piano in a smoky jazz cellar, deep blue light, a brass art-deco sunburst panel glowing softly behind, cigarette-smoke haze, bokeh of brass lamps. Style from the owner's list: Art deco.
A galleon captain's cabin at dawn: an open leather purse spilling silver pieces of eight onto a sea chart, a brass compass and dividers, amber dawn light through the stern windows.
Candlelit crypt reliquary: old silver coins in an open iron reliquary box, black wax seals and blood-red ribbon, a dripping candle, cobwebs, cold stone.

A rain-soaked pawnshop window at 2 a.m.: silver coins on black velvet in the window display, abstract magenta and cyan neon tubes (shapes only, no letters) reflected in wet glass, rain streaks, a faint VHS look (slight chromatic edge split and scan texture). Style from the owner's list: Neon glow, Retro VHS.

Top-down studio photo on pure white paper: one silver coin, a single bold yellow rectangle with a hard black offset shadow, thick black ruled lines; neo-brutalist graphic composition, black and white plus that one yellow. Style from the owner's list: Neo-brutalism.

An old green-phosphor CRT monitor in a dark room showing a coin drawn entirely in ASCII-style glyph characters (dense glyph texture that reads as a coin, never readable words), soft phosphor glow and scanlines, a real silver coin on the desk in front. Style from the owner's list: ASCII art.
A strange old coin suspended in glowing teal fluid inside a laboratory containment cylinder, bioluminescent particles, cold steel, condensation on glass.

Inside a brass telescope dome open to the stars: coins laid out like planets on an antique star chart, a glowing gold wireframe armillary sphere hovering above them (thin luminous lines), deep indigo night. Style from the owner's list: Wireframe 3D.
An alchemist's bench: silver coins in a small crucible beside a glowing glass alembic with emerald liquid, hermetic brass rings, candle and furnace light.

Gold bars and silver coins behind tall frosted-glass panes in a vault carved into Arctic ice; aurora light (teal, green, violet) glowing through and softly refracted by the frosted glass; cold, clean, luminous. Style from the owner's list: Glassmorphism.
Viking hack-silver hoard on a fur pelt: arm rings, cut coins, a silver torc, hearthfire glow, carved wood.
Strings of Chinese cash coins on red lacquer with 24-karat gold foil and a paper lantern glowing, imperial treasury mood.
One old coin on wet slate beside raked gravel in a Kyoto rock garden at dawn, light rain, a few cherry petals.

A coin resting on a brass singing bowl, sandalwood incense smoke curling, the background a dreamy soft gradient of saffron, rose, plum and indigo light fields (out-of-focus colour blending like a gradient mesh). Style from the owner's list: Gradient mesh.
Silver dirhams on a woven carpet in a desert caravanserai at night, lapis-blue tiles, an oil lamp, stars above the courtyard.
